title: Tour the Newly Renovated Common Area at Rose Canyon Safe Parking Site
description:
POV: You're touring the recently renovated common area at the Rose Canyon Safe Parking site, where families experiencing homelessness are working toward more secure housing. A volunteer’s idea inspired this renovation, and a private donation made it possible. Community partners HomeAid, Humble Design San Diego and Swinerton also took part in the transformation. 

The Rose Canyon site has 18 camper trailers specifically designed for family use. This revamped space provides parents and kids a warm area to enjoy meals, charge devices, read or play games and get help with homework. Read more here! insidesandiego.org/community-partners-renovate-rose-canyon-safe-parking-program-space

You can get involved as a volunteer and serve meals to families in the Safe Parking Program! Reach out to our partner and program operator, Jewish Family Service of San Diego, at safeparkingdinners@jfssd.org or 858-637-3050.
